presentation.scene: warm home rice-review tabletop with one consistent natural-wood surface, deep green plants and close food imagery

presenter.note: The source contains only hands, rice, cookware and packaging; no face appears.

render_plan.note: Generate five timed H3 clips carrying all thirteen source microshots. Trim each clip to its exact source window, join without retiming, then lay one continuous English voice-over over the 22.567-second edit.

scene_lock.setting: A compact home dining table staged for a candid vertical rice review, with practical cookware and food close-ups rather than a polished studio set.
scene_lock.surface: One continuous medium-warm brown natural-wood tabletop with a matte finish, fine straight grain running away from camera, and a softly rounded front edge.
scene_lock.backdrop: Deep green broad houseplant leaves fill most of the distant background, with a small cluster of dark red berries and one amber glass vessel off to the right.
scene_lock.lighting: Soft warm window light enters from the front-left, creating gentle highlights and short soft-edged shadows with a neutral-warm white balance.
scene_lock.palette: Warm brown wood, deep botanical green, warm ivory ceramics, pale rice and restrained dark-red accents.
scene_lock.fixed_props: A shallow pale rattan tray, one warm-ivory ceramic rice bowl, dark charcoal chopsticks and one warm-white rice cooker appear only in the shots that require them.

approval.note: approved three-view scene pack; same physical warm wood table
